title: Boiled Potato, fresh, peel eaten, NS for fat

content.title: About
content.content: Boiled potato is fresh potato tubers cooked in salted water until tender. The skin is left on and eaten, adding extra fiber and micronutrients to the dish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato is one of the most widely consumed vegetables worldwide.
Boiling preserves most of the vitamin C if the water is not discarded.
The skin of boiled potatoes contains more potassium and iron than the flesh.
Different cultures serve boiled potatoes with a variety of sauces and seasonings.
There is a tradition of "potato evenings" where the dish is served in salads or as a side.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Both the skin and flesh provide dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potatoes are a good source of potassium, which helps maintain heart and muscle function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Boiled potatoes contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: They contain vitamins B6 and B9, important for metabolism and blood formation.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: The skin holds antioxidant compounds such as phenolics that combat free radicals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Adding salt to the cooking water can increase sodium levels, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Boiled potatoes have a high glycemic index and can raise blood sugar quickly.

items.title: Solanine risk
items.content: If potatoes are damaged or sprouted, the skin may contain solanine, a toxic compound that should be avoided.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Boiled potatoes can be eaten plain, sliced into salads, mashed, or used in casseroles. Keeping the skin on preserves additional nutrients.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store boiled potatoes in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. Over time they may become dry and lose flavor.
